items.summary: United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres today announced the appointment of Toily Kurbanov of the Russian Federation as his new Deputy Special Representative for the United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS) and Resident Coordinator in South Sudan. Mr. Kurbanov will also serve as Humanitarian Coordinator. Mr. Kurbanov succeeds Anita Kiki Gbeho of Ghana, to whom the Secretary-General is grateful for her contributions and accomplishments.

The two officials reaffirmed the important role the U.S.-India strategic partnership continues to play in promoting a safe, secure, and prosperous Indo-Pacific. Secretary Rubio and Minister Jaishankar also exchanged views on developments in the Middle East and beyond. The two also discussed sanctions that could be leveled against states that engage economically with Russia and Iran.
